summary: Pacific Gas and Electric files a two-page notice in the show cause docket, EL26-71-000, on November 16, 2026. It says its section 205 filing was assigned ER27-513-000. The notice has no proposals of its own; the substance is in the earlier filing.

points.point: PG&E reports its section 205 filing and the docket it received.
points.quote: submitted a Section 205 filing responsive to the Order to Show Cause in Docket No. EL26-71-000, which was assigned a new docket number ER27-513-000

points.point: The notice gives the earlier filing's eLibrary accession number.
points.quote: which was assigned a new docket number ER27-513-000, with eLibrary accession number 20261116-5257

throughLine.text: Records that PG&E used the section 205 route the E-10 show cause order allowed, and points the EL26-71 record to the new docket where the proposal sits.
